evidence: Static review; no configured verifier run exists, so runtime permission behaviour is not measured. (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile:9-12 installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1; lines 14-15 COPY only instructions/ and assets/. The environment directory holds only assets/seed_data.json and six instruction notes: no criteria, no judge.toml, no judge CLI, no RewardKit, no solution. The file is byte-identical to the frozen template. (2) Grading lives only in the separate verifier: task.toml:28 environment_mode = "separate"; tests/Dockerfile:16-19,31 install claude-code, playwright-mcp and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 there, and :43-44 COPY . /tests then chmod -R go-rwx /tests. (3) Key: task.toml:34 passes ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} only in [verifier.env]; no literal secret anywhere; test.sh:104-111 starts the submission with env -i (PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH only) as uid/gid 65534, so the key is not in the app's environment. The restart helper repeats this at test.sh:160-167. (4) Reward: test.sh:3 umask 077, :10-12 chmod 700 on the log directory and go-rwx on /tests, so the unprivileged app process cannot read prompts/criteria or write reward.txt/reward.json; test.sh:72-83 zero-scores any /app symlink that resolves outside /app/node_modules. (5) Public text: a grep of instruction.md, all six notes and seed_data.json for judge/rubric/criteri/rewardkit/reward/verifier/scor/gate/weight//tests//logs//solution returned no hit. solve.sh writes only into /app; the golden server.js reads only DB_PATH/SQLITE_PATH and PORT from the environment. test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, .dockerignore, score.py, restart_mcp.py and scoring.toml are byte-identical to the template; task.toml differs only in identity/metadata lines 5-7, 10-12, 14-15. Counterexample attempts: a submission whose server tries to read /tests/scored/functional/judge.toml or overwrite /logs/verifier/reward.json at grade time is blocked by the 65534 drop plus mode 700/go-rwx; one that symlinks /app/x to /tests is zero-scored; a conforming app is unaffected because none of these guards touch normal behaviour. Embedded-instruction attacks on the judge belong to row 45 and were not assessed here.
